article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Brian Griffith scored 17 points as Niagara beat Iona 70-68 on Sunday. A layup by Justin Hawkins provided the winning margin for Niagara with two seconds remaining in the game. Griffith shot 5 for 6 (3 for 3 from 3-point range) and 4 of 5 from the free-throw line for the Purple Eagles (7-19, 4-12 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Vice Zanki scored 12 points, shooting 5 for 8, including 2 for 5 from beyond the arc. Trenton Walters had 11 points and shot 3 of 8 from the field and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line. Toby Harris finished with 18 points for the Gaels (15-12, 7-9). CJ Anthony added 15 points, four assists and three steals for Iona. Kosy Akametu also had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
